plugins.name: ppt-master
plugins.description: AI-driven SVG+PPTX generation. **v2.8.0** (synced upstream hugohe3): LaTeX formula rendering, brand presets, topic-research/resume-execute workflows, richer object animations. **mosjin fork adds**: page_order.txt manifest ordering in pptx_discovery (frame-id-named SVGs insert without renumbering; backward compatible) + `--absolute-links` (file:/// URLs for WPS/PowerPoint hyperlink resolution). Earlier: v2.7.x parse_hex_color CSS-named-colors, SVG quality gate. Run `pip install -r requirements.txt` in the installed plugin dir for Python post-processing.
